p.b: One idea: if you can tokenise it, a transformer can model it
p.small: text → sub-words · image → patches · audio → frames

p.b: Q1 · How do we fuse modalities?

p.small: contrastive: pull the diagonal, push the rest · 400M pairs · InfoNCE · ⇒ zero-shot (the classifier head became a sentence)

Modular (LLaVA) — frozen LLM + projection
cheap, capped

p.b: Q2 · How do we generate them?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Diffusion — destroy with noise, learn to reverse
forward q: fixed, closed form (cheap training) · reverse p_θ: learned, plain MSE L = E‖ε − ε_θ(x_t,t)‖²

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: The whole model is an ε-predictor — everything below is built around it

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: what it predicts — ε / x₀ / v · schedules (cosine beats linear) · Min-SNR · zero-terminal SNR

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: how you step — DDPM 1000 → DDIM 50 → DPM++ 20 → (retrain) distill 4 → consistency 1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: how hard it obeys — CFG: ε̂ = ε_∅ + w(ε_txt − ε_∅) · w ≈ 7–8 · faithful vs diverse

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: where it runs — latent diffusion 786k → 16k (48×) ⇒ Stable Diffusion on a consumer GPU

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: what kind of network — U-Net (skips carry detail) → DiT (patchify, adaLN-Zero, scales like an LLM) ⇒ SD3, Flux, Sora · video = spacetime patches (temporal consistency unsolved)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: how you steer it — text → cross-attn · ControlNet (structure) · IP-Adapter (style) · they compose · editing needs no new model (img2img, inpaint, instruct, DDIM inversion)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: Diffusion comes back for text — mask instead of Gaussian noise · parallel unmasking · but no streaming / no KV cache → hybrids

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

p.b: How do we know it works?
p.small: FID (blind to prompt) · CLIP-score (gameable) · precision / recall · GenEval · human preference → report a basket · benchmarks saturate, get contaminated, get gamed

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: these models are powerful but passive — what if they could act? → agents
